notes.title: The Goalkeeping Simulator
notes.content:
Homo Flimsy - The Ragdoll Goalkeeping Simulator!

This major update bring more focus on fun! New inclusions help the game feel more unique, tight and enjoyable by concentrating on bringing Henry to the limelight. 

Hope you all love it!

notes.title: Homo Flimsy Pre-Release
notes.content: The final muscles are being stretched, joints hyper-extended. Homo Flimsy is almost ready for release, awaiting to be flipped, flopped, twisted, spun and slung across computers everywhere. Get ready to play solo or with a friend as the world's most elite goalkeeping prospects. Can you gain your first international cap?
